trial_court: Senior Civil Judge, Kovvu, SPSR Nellore, HMOP No.66 of 2018
case_name: Petitioner v. Respondent — full case name
facts_of_case: The husband and wife were married in 1995. The wife filed an application for interim maintenance under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act. The trial court granted Rs.3,000/- per month as interim maintenance. The husband is challenging this order.

legal_principles.principle: Either the wife or the husband has no independent income sufficient for her or his support and the necessary expenses of the proceedings, the Court may order interim maintenance.
legal_principles.held: Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act provides that, either the wife or the husband has no independent income sufficient for her or his support and the necessary expenses of the proceedings, the Court may order interim maintenance.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking maintenance to establish that they are entitled to it.
legal_principles.held: Though the present petition came to be filed seeking maintenance ...

outcome.final_order: The final court order was to grant an amount of Rs.3,000/- per month as interim maintenance to the wife.
